method: Independent local-moment high-temperature proxy: mean_i ln(1+|m_i|/muB); g approximately 2, orbital contribution neglected
excluded: md_400steps.run002.out: first force frame omitted: header coordinates do not verify restart geometry
limitations: Constrained atomic magnetization: no equilibrium sampling of spin configurations.
This is an assumed independent-local-moment degeneracy model, not entropy inferred from spin probabilities.
Noninteger DFT moments depend on local projection; model uncertainty is not quantified.
Frame standard deviation describes trajectory variation, not an uncertainty of the mean; frames are correlated.
No magnetic short-range correlations, orbital entropy, or calibrated longitudinal-spin measure included.
Do not automatically add -T*S to Helmholtz free energy; assess magnetic model and double counting first.
